about: Fixed settings for every video from the app's inbox (v3/inbox.py, .github/workflows/inbox.yml). best = run 4's recipe exactly (the owner's best: ~420 frames, 1440 px, 30k steps, 1.5M splats); run 6 (900 frames, 1920 px, 40k, 3M) looked worse to the owner (28 Oct). quick = a short test run (end-to-end check, not for viewing). Since 1 Nov 'best' and 'home' size every run from the video itself (AUTO_STEPS): frames by walking time (run 4's 411 frames per 123 s, at most 1,000), splats by floor area (run 4's 1.5 M per 37 m2, 1.5-4 M), steps by training views (83.6 each), plus run 4's 2DGS geometry model for walk collision; a full-size dry run measures speed and memory first and the job only starts what fits in Kaggle's time.

home.note: same rules as best (sized from the video); kept as a name the app may send
